scientific_integrity: Complete proof and standalone finite diagnostics supplied; numerical tests are not used as proof of infinite results. Public primary literature and known parabolic theory acknowledged. Authorship, publication priority, and independence are not certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact statement restricted to invariant unequal two-cluster states with identical natural frequencies and quadrature phase lag. title: Sharp no-slip locking and logarithmic relaxation at quadrature phase lag
